name: Cormac's Glossary
text: Cormac's Glossary is the English name for the Sanas Cormaic, an early Irish glossary of rare and old words. Tradition gives the work to Cormac mac Cuilennáin, the king-bishop of Cashel who died in 908. His readings often set divine figures among mortal kings. He places Manannán mac Lir on the Isle of Man rather than in the otherworldly Emain Ablach. Scholars still cite the glossary for the oldest layers of Irish tradition.
